note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), who transcribed the descriptions of Roonwal and Chhotani (1965) and Akhtar (1975); the original is in English and all three castes are available; the soldier body length is given in the original as 'c 4.0-7.0 mm', the worker postclypeus length as '0.20-21' and the worker pronotum width as '0.47.0.50', all suspected OCR errors and therefore not recorded; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, sides nearly parallel; mandibles short and thick, base wide, basal width/mandible length ratio 0.64; left mandible with a distinct tooth at the apical third and 2 additional weak basal denticles; postmentum slender, club-shaped, widest at the anterior third, waist near the posterior margin; pronotum wider than long, anterior and posterior margins both convex and without a notch. Alate head capsule dark brown, slightly paler anteriorly, postclypeus length about half its width.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow to yellow, with a brownish tinge; antennae, postclypeus, labrum, legs and thorax paler than the head; mandibles brown, paler at the base. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length to mandible base 1.44–1.50 mm, width 1.10–1.18 mm; sides nearly parallel, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle and coronal suture indistinct. Postclypeus flat, oval, hairy; anteclypeus trapezoidal, slightly projecting anteriorly in the middle. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped, labral body and anterior margin with short and long hairs, anterior margin truncate and slightly curved inward; length 0.27 mm, width 0.33 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 nearly equal to segment 2 in length, segment 4 shortest. Mandibles short and thick, base wide; length 0.70–0.73 mm, basal width 0.47 mm. Left mandible with a distinct tooth at the apical third and 2 additional weak basal denticles; tooth of the right mandible as in the left mandible, with 1 additional small basal denticle; left tooth distance from apex/mandible length ratio 0.23. Postmentum slender, club-shaped, widest at the anterior third, narrowing posteriorly into a waist near the posterior margin; length 0.78–1.00 mm, maximum width 0.33–0.41 mm, waist width 0.20–0.26 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, wider than long; length 0.33–0.35 mm, maximum width 0.57–0.62 mm; anterior margin convex, without a notch; posterior margin curved outward, without a concavity or notch.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale straw yellow; antennae, labrum, legs and thorax paler; abdomen greyish owing to gut contents showing through. Body length 3.50–3.80 mm. Head capsule subcircular; maximum width 0.80–0.84 mm, head length to mandible base 0.67–0.73 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Postclypeus hairy, raised, length about half its width; width 0.37–0.39 mm; anteclypeus sub-trapezoidal, hairless, slightly projecting anteriorly in the middle. Labrum wide, tongue-shaped. Pronotum as in the soldier, length 0.20–0.28 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, slightly paler anteriorly; postclypeus paler; antennae light brown; pronotum light brown with a smoky tinge; legs yellowish brown; abdominal dorsum as dark as the pronotum. Head and pronotum densely hairy, with numerous short hairs and a few long hairs. Head subcircular, wider than the head length to mandible base; head length 0.68–0.78 mm, maximum width 0.96–1.06 mm; coronal suture faintly visible. Fontanelle small, circular. Eyes subcircular, prominent; maximum diameter 0.27–0.29 mm, minimum diameter 0.24–0.27 mm. Ocelli broadly oval; distance to the eye equal to their short diameter (long diameter 0.09–0.11 mm, short diameter 0.07–0.09 mm, distance between eye and ocellus 0.07 mm). Postclypeus weakly raised, length nearly half its width; length 0.18–0.22 mm, maximum width 0.41–0.46 mm; median line indistinct. Labrum dome-shaped. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum flat, slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin shallowly curved inward and without a notch, posterior margin curved inward in the middle; length 0.51–0.57 mm, width 0.85–0.98 mm.
